display.purpose: the case-study title. One per page.

headline.purpose: chapter headings inside a case study. The next-post link uses the same size at 400 (22px under 600px).

post-title.purpose: post titles in the feed (22px under 600px). Hover draws a 1px underline from the left over 0.35s.

title.purpose: the profile bio, which is the home page's h1 (21px under 900px).

body.purpose: post captions (max 62ch) and the base size.

name.purpose: the person's name wherever it appears as an identity: top-bar breadcrumb, profile, byline.

label.purpose: buttons, breadcrumb trail, byline, back link, spec values.

meta.purpose: dates, chips, the outline pill, stats, the table-of-contents title, the footer.

spec.purpose: the catalogue line under each post and figure captions.

shadows.name: live-halo
shadows.purpose: Halo around the 7px availability dot. The only box-shadow in the build; not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve (expo-out) for every transition.

motion.name: duration-color
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on buttons, chips, links.

motion.name: duration-underline
motion.purpose: Post-title underline drawing from the left.

motion.name: duration-hint
motion.purpose: Media hover arrow easing in from a 6px diagonal offset.

motion.name: feedback-hold
motion.purpose: How long copy feedback (check icon, 'Copiado', link tooltip) stays.

breakpoints.name: two-column
breakpoints.purpose: At and below: 280px aside + fluid main; top bar stops sticking.

breakpoints.name: one-column
breakpoints.purpose: At and below: single column, 16px gutters, profile becomes header, TOC hidden, 56px top bar.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: At and below: secondary top-bar buttons and breadcrumb trail hide; post actions wrap under the title; spec sheet 2 columns.

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is a profile, and the work is its feed. Every case study is a dated post: a date line, a title row that carries its own two actions (share, read), raw media, a one-idea caption and a catalogue line of role, team, duration and platform. Opening a post leads to the full case study: byline, display title, lede, a spec sheet, chapters and a link to the next post. The system exists to make that format feel like a well-made product rather than a brochure.

Everything is drawn in one warm graphite ink on pure white paper. Greys are not a separate palette; they are the same ink thinned toward the ground on the same warm hue (about 107° in OKLCH, near-zero chroma). One family, Figtree, carries the whole hierarchy at two weights: 500 for headings and names, 400 for everything else. Rank comes from size, ink tone and space. Media sits directly on the ground with a 6px corner and no frame; there are no cards and no shadows. The only colour that is not ink is a small green dot that means "available for work".

The page is wide and symmetric: the feed sits in the exact centre of a 1680px page, the profile is pinned to the bottom of the left column like a social profile, and the top bar has no surface at all, floating over the empty side columns. Density is calm and editorial: 88px between posts, tight stacks inside them, measured line lengths (62 to 64ch). Motion is small and physical on one expo-out curve; the signature moment is the media hover, where the image takes a faint veil, zooms slightly and shows a large thin arrow whose colour reads the image beneath it.

The ground (#FFFFFF), the darkest ink (#272724) and the line, fill and raised neutrals are user-chosen and binding. Figtree was chosen by the user over Instrument Sans, Inter Tight, Urbanist, Open Sans and Coolvetica.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite on white: one ink (#272724) and its thinned tones on a pure white ground.
One family (Figtree), two weights: 500 for headings and names, 400 for the rest. Never bolder.
Raw media on the ground, 4:3, 6px corners; no cards, no shadows, no frames.
Pills for everything you press; 1px hairlines for everything that divides.
A single accent, the green availability dot.
Symmetric three-column page (1680px) with the 680px feed centred; two columns under 1200px, one under 900px.
Chrome without a surface: the top bar floats, the carousel has no controls.

rules.name: The Thinned Ink Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is the ink diluted toward the ground on the same warm hue. A new grey that drifts cool or picks up chroma does not belong; derive it from `ink` and `ground`.

rules.name: The One Dot Rule
rules.body: Green appears once per screen, as the availability dot. It never becomes a button, link, highlight or chart colour.

rules.name: The Decoration-Only Rule
rules.body: `ink-3` never carries text a reader needs. If it must be read, it is `ink-2`.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Weight 500 is for headings and the person's name; 400 is for everything else. Nothing is set heavier than 500, and emphasis inside text comes from `ink` against `ink-2`, not from weight.

rules.name: The Catalogue Voice Rule
rules.body: Facts about the work (role, team, duration, platform, figure captions) are set small (12 to 13px) in `ink-2` with +0.01em tracking, separated by `ink-3` middots in a line or by a full-ink rule in the spec sheet. That is the only change of voice the type makes.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and headings are sentence case. No uppercase, no tracked-out small labels.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Posts, media, lists, the top bar and controls sit directly on the ground with no shadow and no card. Separation is a hairline or a change of tone.

dos: Do build every grey from the ink and ground on the same warm hue (The Thinned Ink Rule); keep `ink-2` as the lightest colour for readable text.
Do set headings and names in Figtree 500 and everything else in 400; rank by size, `ink`/`ink-2` tone and space.
Do keep the feed centred in the 1680px page with equal side columns, and the home profile anchored to the bottom of the viewport.
Do make anything pressable a full pill (999px) or a circle, and anything that divides a 1px hairline.
Do place media raw on the ground at 4:3 with a 6px corner, and give linked media the veil, 1.02 zoom and background-aware arrow on hover.
Do keep the Contactar primary pill visible in the top bar at every width.
Do use the expo-out curve for all motion and respect reduced motion.
Do draw icons as round-capped line drawings on a 20px grid in `currentColor`.
donts: Don't change the ground (#FFFFFF), the darkest ink (#272724) or the line, fill and raised neutrals; they are binding.
Don't wrap posts, media or lists in cards, borders or shadows, and don't give the top bar a fill or a divider.
Don't introduce a second accent. Green is only the availability dot.
Don't set type heavier than 500, in uppercase, or as letter-spaced small labels.
Don't add a second typeface or a condensed cut; Figtree carries everything.
Don't add dots, arrows or counters to the carousel.
Don't add engagement counts or reaction buttons to posts; a post's only actions are share and read.
